notes.title: Primateria: Reburn is Now on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone,![/h1]

We’ve just taken a big step forward—[b]Primateria: Reburn[/b] now has its official Steam page!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3725470/Primateria_Reburn/

This marks the beginning of the next chapter we’ve been quietly building toward—with your help.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]From the heart of the Hollow Lands, a new legend begins.[/h2]

[b]Primateria: Reburn[/b] is more than a collectible card game—it’s a full [i]TCG life simulator[/i] where lore, community, and strategy merge.

Rise from cozy card shop duels to world championships in a vibrant magepunk world where cards aren’t just paper—they’re the language of gods, dreams, and destiny.

[h3]The Journey: From Card Shop to Legend[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Local Tournaments:[/b] Weekly casuals, Swiss brackets, and shop events earn you rare cards, Rep Points, and Village Prestige.
[*][b]Regionals:[/b] Explore Wind, Water, and Fire-themed metas with rotating rules and challenges.
[*][b]Nationals:[/b] Duel in floating cities, underwater arenas, and crystalline spires. Face elite NPCs and players.
[*][b]The Reverie Cup:[/b] The dream-bound world championship where the battlefield bends to your will.
[/list]

[h3]Real TCG Progression Meets Magical Realism[/h3]
[list]
[*]Play casuals, climb ranked, and explore formats like Highlander, Draft, Tag Duels, and Budget.
[*]Build dream combos and test them across shops and events.
[*]NPC duelists use competitive, hand-tuned decks.
[*]Relationships evolve, rivalries grow—your legend is yours to write.
[/list]

[h3]A Real Card Shop Feel[/h3]
[list]
[*]Trade cards, talk meta, and spectate duels.
[*]Shops are alive with culture—gossips, rivalries, and spontaneous trades.
[*]NPCs remember you and unlock new events and tag-team duels.
[*]Mid-duel trades, deck lending, and character arcs await.
[/list]

[h3]Systems That Support the Fantasy[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Pseudo-Smartphone:[/b] Tournament standings, events, and social info at a glance.
[*][b]Card Binder:[/b] Browse, sort, and filter your entire collection from the duel table.
[*][b]Trade Groups:[/b] Arrange meetups and negotiate deals with NPCs.
[*][b]Achievements:[/b] Unlock content by defeating bosses and gaining access to rarer formats or legendary cards.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[b]Discord is where this game will grow.[/b]
We’ll be running feedback threads, early playtests, and sneak peeks directly with our community.
Your thoughts, your ideas, your decks—they’ve always helped shape Primateria. Now more than ever, they’ll shape what comes next.

We’re building this alongside you, one card at a time.

[hr][/hr]

Thank you for sticking with us, playing the original, sharing feedback, and believing in what this strange little card game could become.
We’re just getting started.

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3725470/f9bfacd947feef85da33ea97f15de01651da5c09/header.jpg?t=1747341737[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3725470/Primateria_Reburn/]→ Wishlist Primateria: Reburn on Steam[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/primateria]→ Join our Discord for updates and playtests[/url]

notes.title: Primateria Reburn is Coming!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Primateria Community![/h1]

In our [b]last announcement[/b], we promised that more exciting news was coming, and today we’re thrilled to share exactly what that is. We’ve also got a fresh set of updates for [b]Primateria[/b] itself, so read on for the details!

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Card Changes and Balancing Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Soul Devouring Crab[/b]  
The effect now reads "From mana" instead of "On fusion," providing more flexibility on when to use this ability. It also opens up new synergies with cards like Adventurer's Toolkit, so deck builders rejoice!

[*][b]New Rules for Disabled Cards[/b]  
At the start of a player's turn, any of their disabled cards will become bound instead. This change is intended to weaken strategies that fully lock down a player by occupying all their zones.  
(Note: Disabled cards will still become enabled/unbound at the end of their owner’s turn, as before.)

[*][b]Enhancements, fixes, and other small changes[/b]  
Many bugs were fixed—especially in Daily Deck. Thank you to everyone who reported them!
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]New Artwork: Convoy Bison[/h2]

We’re thrilled to reveal the brand-new [b]Convoy Bison[/b] artwork! This design breathes fresh life into one of our beloved behemoths. Keep an eye out for it in your next match and let us know what you think!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/94e7ed1730d2257611aa8970b72f62e4bc2a4fcf.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Primateria Reburn is Coming![/h2]

Over the past year, we’ve worked tirelessly on [b]Primateria[/b]—rolling out major updates, adding new content, and listening closely to your feedback. We’ve learned so much along the way and remain deeply grateful for your incredible support.

Today, we’re finally ready to unveil our [b]next big project[/b]:  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/a47c37165abb3134490637b9f4d4602722578d7d.png[/img]

[quote]“A bold new TCG adventure fusing single-player exploration with a vibrant social hub—build your deck, explore shops, collect cosmetics, challenge fearsome AI and real players alike, and leave your mark on the Primateria world!”[/quote]

[h2]Overview[/h2]

[b]Primateria Reburn[/b] reimagines the essence of Primateria, blending deck collection, trading, and challenging battles with enhanced community features that encourage social interaction. Whether you enjoy mastering single-player campaigns or going head-to-head with fellow players, Reburn offers the best of both worlds.

[h2]Game Concept[/h2]

As a direct sequel to the original Primateria, Reburn keeps the core card-battling system you love but expands into a fully-realized TCG world with new features:

[list]
[*][b]Explore Shops & Collect More Than Just Packs[/b]  
Visit multiple in-game shops to find exclusive card packs, powerful items, and rare cosmetic collectibles.  
Customize your avatar, deck box, and board to truly make your mark.

[*][b]Primateria Battles: Single-Player & PvP[/b]  
[i]Single-Player:[/i] Tackle advanced AI opponents and experience the evolution of the popular symmetric boss battles. Each encounter is deeper, harder, and full of surprises.  
[i]PvP:[/i] Challenge friends or match against other players to test your newest combos and strategies. Climb the ladder or create custom lobbies for friendly skirmishes.

[*][b]Social Hub[/b]  
[i]Hang Out & Interact:[/i] Join a dynamic social space populated by both players and AI characters. Discuss deck builds, seek advice, or simply relax and share your latest pack pulls.  
[i]Trades & Drafts:[/i] Trade cards with others to complete your collection or host thrilling draft events where each choice can lead to your next great synergy.  
[i]Tournaments & Events:[/i] Compete in organized tournaments—both casual and high-stakes—and participate in seasonal events that keep the meta fresh and exciting.
[/list]

By steadily building your collection, showcasing your style with unique cosmetics, and immersing yourself in a lively community, [b]Primateria Reburn[/b] promises a richer, more connected card-battling journey than ever before.

[h2]Early Development Sneak Peek[/h2]

We’re still early in development, so expect many things to change. In the meantime, here’s a small taste of what’s in store. Please note that all visuals below are [b]placeholders[/b], early drafts, or experiments as we shape [b]Primateria Reburn[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/d82b8ebcb5ad917ea6840547aab3126b4e2dc705.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/35ea38ecdf892c40bac09c2491943b39da13354e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/d8c6e5ee9c303273e56c26f60d3466501d31f55c.png[/img]

We’ll have more to share as development continues—stay tuned!

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Final Words[/h2]

As always, your feedback and enthusiasm keep [b]Primateria[/b] evolving. While we’ll continue to maintain Primateria (the original), our primary focus will shift toward [b]Primateria Reburn[/b]. We’re incredibly proud of what the first game achieved and grateful to everyone who played and supported it through countless matches, events, and updates.

[quote]Servers will remain open, and the feedback, Daily Deck entries, and analytics from the original Primateria will help inform and shape Reburn. We can’t wait for you to explore this new social frontier of Primateria and share your thoughts on the evolving TCG experience![/quote]

If you’d like to connect with us, [url=https://discord.com/invite/KSUsJ8VnSQ]Join Our Discord[/url], follow us on [url=https://instagram.com/yfritgames]Instagram @yfritgames[/url], or find us on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/yfrit.social]Bluesky[/url]. You can also reach out via our website’s contact form at [url=https://yfrit.com]www.yfrit.com[/url] or by email at [b]contact@yfrit.com[/b].

Thank you for your ongoing support,  
[b]Yfrit Team[/b]

notes.title: Contest Artwork Collection and Balancing Tweaks!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Primateria Community![/h1]

We’re excited to bring you another update, packed with some of the latest features and tweaks based on your feedback. This minor update rounds out our recent changes as well as new artwork and changes to our Steam page.

[h2]Complete Artwork Collection[/h2]

We’re thrilled to announce that the final 2 designs from our [b]SuperXP 2024 Artwork Contest[/b] have now been added, completing the set of [b]all five winning artworks[/b]! Each unique design, crafted in collaboration with our talented players and our artist [url=https://www.instagram.com/duckartisan/]@DuckArtisan[/url], is now available in-game. Show off these exclusive pieces in your deck and let your opponents marvel at your custom card collection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/a81210d97167575fbad7afc415f8fbe8ea670e83.png[/img]

[h2]New Achievement: Tribute[/h2]

Introducing the [b]"Tribute"[/b] achievement! To earn this accolade, players must beat a boss in Endless Mode using all five artwork winner cards in their deck. It’s a true test of skill and a tribute to our community’s creativity!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/571e0abf8633cd2959ae48e41ea0f701e75cb679.png[/img]

[h2]Card Changes and Balancing Updates[/h2]

To keep gameplay balanced and exciting, we’ve made several key adjustments to card effects and mechanics. Here’s a look at some of the changes:

[list]
[*][b]The Zealot[/b]: Effect now reads "up to 2" instead of "2", allowing more flexibility in the zone locked format.
[*][b]Cursed Coin[/b]: Resolves with "add this card to your hand" instead of creating a copy to prevent exponential cloning.
[*][b]Battlemage[/b]: Effect is now restricted to once per turn.
[*][b]Ignis Snail[/b]: Only triggers on the opponent’s turn, making it still usable defensively, but preventing free board wipes with other self-damage cards.
[*][b]Painful Exchange[/b]: Draws 2 cards instead of 3.
[*][b]Pandemonium Lost[/b]: Now causes "damage" instead of "discard".
[*][b]Wide-Head Miner[/b]: Disables itself if no draw is possible.
[*][b]Cataclysm[/b]: Effect now reads "up to 3" instead of "3", allowing more flexibility in the zone locked format.
[*][b]Egg Snatcher[/b]: Can now play from both damage and discard piles.
[*][b]Slime, the Jam[/b]: Effect was changed to "On damage (by battle): create as many level 1 tokens as possible. From damage: discard all tokens in your arena, play this card". This simplifies the card without taking away from the token multiplying nature.
[*][b]All-Mother, Aian[/b]: To prevent some unintended OTKs, now requires 5 materia to be played and the effect can no longer be copied.

[h2]Steam Store Overhaul[/h2]

We’ve refreshed our [b]Steam Store assets[/b] with new artwork to better showcase Primateria’s unique style and gameplay. Visit the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1397130/Primateria/]Primateria Steam Page[/url] and check out the updated visuals!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/760be0371415921c151df841998ed2211fa91495.png[/img]

[h2]Daily Deck Milestone[/h2]

A big thank you to everyone participating in the [b]Daily Deck challenge[/b]! We’re thrilled to see almost [b]2,000 daily deck and random deck challenges[/b] so far! Your continued support and creativity make this feature a cornerstone of the Primateria experience. Our team is having a ton of fun facing your decks every day! Keep them coming!

[h2]Additional Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*]Multiple bug fixes and minor improvements.
[*]Minor UI tweaks for a more seamless user experience.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/ad68df6918aaec827d07ada0dde4c2fe02603740.png[/img]

[h2]Final Words[/h2]

As always, we’re incredibly grateful for your feedback and support. Primateria has been out for nearly a year now, and since day one, we've been dedicated to enhancing your experience—releasing patches, hosting events, running giveaways and art contests, and so much more, all made possible by your amazing support.

In our last announcement, we hinted at some exciting news for the future of Primateria. While we’re eager to share these plans, we’re still working hard to finalize the details before making an official announcement. It’s taking a bit longer than expected, and we appreciate your patience as we get everything ready.

In the meantime, please don’t hesitate to [url=https://discord.com/invite/KSUsJ8VnSQ]Join Our Discord[/url] or follow us on [url=https://instagram.com/yfritgames]Instagram @yfritgames[/url] to stay connected and share your thoughts on the latest updates. Feel free to shoot us a message through our contact form on our website [url=https://yfrit.com]www.yfrit.com[/url], or send us an email at contact@yfrit.com. We've also recently completely [url=https://bsky.app/profile/yfrit.social]migrated to Bluesky[/url] as a new social media platform, you can follow and contact us there too.

We hope you enjoy these new features and can’t wait to hear what you think!

Thank you,  
Yfrit Team

notes.title: The Daily Deck Major Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Primateria Community![/h1]

We know it’s been a while, but we’re thrilled to finally bring you the next major update. After taking your feedback and doing extensive research on what to prioritize, we’ve focused on delivering the most requested features. We hope this update makes your gameplay even more enjoyable!

[h2]Here’s what’s new:[/h2]

[h3]Daily Deck Feature[/h3]

Introducing the [b]Daily Deck[/b] challenge! Players can now take on a new player deck every day. Each daily deck will be selected from the decks that beat the challenge from the previous day. Beating the Daily Deck also unlocks a new mode where you can battle against random decks from other players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/a6bedebd1cb7a60882c3fd3d3c817c98f64efe97.png[/img]

[h3]Zone Locking[/h3]

For the daily deck feature, following your feedback on our playtests regarding first-turn kills (FTKs) and one-turn kills (OTKs) being too common, we've introduced a zone locking mechanic to balance early game advantage. Both players now start with 3 locked zones, leaving only 2 zones available. At the start of each turn (except the first turn of each player), one locked zone is unlocked. This change helps prevent early game domination while still allowing for strategic fusion plays without overwhelming first turns. It also evens the playing field for the player going first, as they will always be the first to unlock new zones, while the second player has the advantage of being the first to attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/eda2c2fba91de4ba6c4cba68d30823a578fbba7a.png[/img]

[h3]Redesigned Attack Experience[/h3]

Based on your feedback, we’ve reworked the attack experience to make it smoother and more intuitive, especially for new players. You can now attack using drag-and-drop, click individually, or a mix of both. We’ve also added a new prompt asking if you want to enter the battle phase when dragging your cards to the opponent's.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/319256dafa2916a2fefdf571e624dcf64f4d48e4.png[/img]

[h3]Keyword Tool Tips[/h3]

Another highly requested feature — keyword tool tips are now available when you hover over cards, displaying detailed descriptions of each keyword. If you prefer a cleaner UI, this feature can be disabled from the options menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/df146e2708e02fd6ad71e34dc5366f05884e286d.png[/img]

[h3]Artwork Contest[/h3]

During the SuperXP 2024 event in Joinville, we held a special challenge where players who beat the challenge run had the opportunity to collaborate with our artist [url=https://www.instagram.com/duckartisan/]@DuckArtisan[/url] (please follow him on Instagram!) to create their own custom card artwork. With dozens of sketches made and over 400 votes cast, the top 3 designs were selected and transformed into custom artwork for cards in the game. These unique player-created artworks are now available, and we’re excited to announce that [b]2 more winning designs[/b] will be featured in the next update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/71af8a70289c22d4c4d2c9adc957fd176c79f61a.png[/img]

[h3]Steam Community Items[/h3]

We’ve also added new Steam Community items to enhance your Primateria experience! You can now unlock and collect:

[list]
[*] 6 Trading Cards
[*] 5 Emoticons
[*] Badges for Level 1-5 and the Foil Badge
[*] 3 Profile Backgrounds
[/list]

Show off your progress and customize your profile with these new items while playing the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/73db45866b99fa4876a4493e265dcc153691ff91.png[/img]

[h3]Additional Updates[/h3]

[list]
[*] A range of new micro-feedback has been added for actions like trying to attack the deck directly or playing high-level cards without fusing, helping new players understand mechanics better.
[*] Improved AI behavior for a more challenging experience.
[*] New artwork for 3 cards, additional to the 3 from our community artwork contest!
[*] Minor card effect changes to improve synergies and overall game balance.
[*] As always, we’ve fixed multiple bugs and made several performance improvements.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/23cbb4e68e6528ecfbd2c18934d0801bd417017e.png[/img]

[h2]Final Notes[/h2]

We’re also very excited to share that we have some [b]BIG news[/b] coming in the next update — though we’re not quite ready to reveal it just yet! Stay tuned for more details, and we promise this next update won’t take as long to arrive. We're already ironing things out with our publisher [url=https://surefire.games]Surefire.Games[/url] so news should be coming soon.

Thank you so much for your continued support and patience. Don’t forget to [url=https://discord.com/invite/KSUsJ8VnSQ]Join Our Discord[/url] to share your feedback and connect with the Primateria community, or reach out to us via our Instagram [url=https://instagram.com/yfritgames]@yfritgames[/url] or on our website at [url=https://yfritgames.com]https://yfritgames.com[/url].

We hope you enjoy this update, and we can’t wait to hear what you think!

Thanks again for your support,  
Yfrit Team

notes.title: New Content and Exciting News
notes.content:
[b]What's up Primateria Community![/b]

It's been a while since our last update, but for good reason. We've been hard at work on new content, new modes and a lot of cool stuff we've been prototyping.

While we work on our next major update, we wanted to keep the updates coming for you guys to make sure content is always fresh!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/2d6b9a384609cc93c113e1079747829cf91b2064.png[/img]

Here's what's new:

- [b]Boss Rush[/b] mode: a new mode where you can now face random bosses in a run structure. All available bosses in the game can appear as challenges.
- [b]Tamera and Meros[/b] join the roster of legendary cards.
- Following your feedback, we have the reworked damage mechanic: cards in damage return to your deck at the end of battle. A dummy card is added to the damage to represent damage points. That way, your deck cards are no longer locked.
- Improved the pinata node to be more effective for effect based decks, now you can earn gold with most deck styles, not only attack based ones.
- 11 new cards focusing on untapped combos and mechanics such as links.
- 3 new decks with new / improved playstyles.
- 9 new achievements that go together with the new content.
- Replaced art for multiple cards with new custom artwork.
- Bug fixes, enhancements, balancing and other small changes.

[b]More to come![/b] 

It should take us a little longer until the next major update, but we're very excited about the things we've been cooking for the last couple of months. With that in mind, we're releasing a new version before that with a lot of new content while we wait on the major update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/a5d38a6a8de6ce29afa511bf9712158784abb1e1.png[/img]

For now, we hope you enjoy the new content and changes!

Thanks for your support,
Yfrit Team.

notes.title: The Deck Editor Major Update
notes.content:
Hello Primateria Community!

We're finally back with the exciting first major update based on your feedback and suggestions. This update introduces some significant features and enhancements to improve your gameplay experience in Primateria.

Here's what's new:

[h3]Deck Editor[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players can now create, edit, save, and delete their own custom decks using the cards they have unlocked. These decks can be used to start endless runs and quests.
[*] Difficulty dynamically changes to balance runs using custom decks. Adding more cards to your deck will make the run more challenging.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/38c33525e014cf0e151e2a5c25a5c7677decba73.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/a8072ff8736724c157971b164909ed9c729a8477.png[/img]

[h3]Boss Rush Quests[/h3]
[list]
[*] We've added a new era with 4 new quests, introducing a boss rush mode where all battles are boss battles.
[*] The new quests feature new super-bosses at the end, providing extra challenge and requiring advanced strategies to defeat.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/7c301a3bb5cf4296ffef61c12b3eb419d217d95d.png[/img]

[h3]Additional Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] 7 new Equipment items have been added.
[*] 7 new achievements to unlock.
[*] 5 new cards have been added.
[*] Abandoning a run now grants experience similarly to losing a run.
[*] Some card arts have been replaced.
[*] Balancing changes include a rework of the "Convoy Bison" card, improved monster parties for initial floors to reduce frustration, and a rebalanced unlock progression to encourage exploration of new cards.
[*] We've also implemented multiple bug fixes, small changes, and optimizations to improve game performance and stability.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/78ad73f4f9b11ec292950e9462b676a847c93538.png[/img]

Your feedback is crucial to us, and we're committed to continuously improving Primateria.

Don't forget to [url=https://discord.com/invite/KSUsJ8VnSQ]Join Our Discord[/url] to share your feedback, opinions, criticism or if just want to chat about the game! You can also contact us in any of our social media platforms [url=https://twitter.com/YfritGames]@yfritgames[/url] or contact us through our website at https://yfritgames.com. We'd love to see what you cook with the new deck editor!

We hope you enjoy the new content and changes!

Stay tuned for more updates, and don't hesitate to share your thoughts and suggestions!

Thanks for your support,
Yfrit Team.

notes.title: New Minor Update Rolled Out!
notes.content:
Hello Primateria Community!

We wanted to first of all thank you for the feedback you provided during the playtest, your participation was very important, and we're very happy that the changes made helped improve the Primateria experience!

This minor update incorporates all the changes made for the playtest, alongside other fixes based on your feedback.

Here's the list of changes:

[h3]Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Card rewards are no longer mandatory when winning battles; they can be skipped.
[*] Divine Sacrifice and Transmutation nodes can now be skipped.
[*] Special unlock conditions for the legendary cards are now available in the gallery.
[*] Information about the current challenge is now displayed on the Battle screen.
[*] Difficulty is now clearly displayed on the quest selection screen and on the ending screen if you choose to keep your deck.
[*] Multiple bug fixes and other minor changes.
[*] The tutorial now explains the attack on deck mechanic.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Battles now give two cards as reward instead of one.
[*] Balanced the Battle in Waves node; it now has a battle phase, and the difficulty was adjusted.
[*] Balanced boss battles: improved AI and adjusted combos accordingly with difficulty.
[*] Balanced run difficulty: you can now only keep your deck for one era instead of all quests; the difficulty of the next quest when keeping deck was also increased.
[/list]

[h3]Cards Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Skin Wearer can now only target cards in the backrow. It could easily steal a powerful high level card and deal a lot of damage in a single turn, and the only way to prevent that was by removing it from the arena. Now, it can be countered by moving the high level cards to the front row and only leaving weak cards in the back.
[*] Ethereal Beast was removed from the enemy card pool, and is now a player-only card. If left alive, its effect of attacking mana would always do guaranteed damage to the player, without offering any kind of counter-play apart from removal.
[*] Convoy Bison was also removed from the enemy card pool, but for the opposite reason. Using any removal effect would easily circunvent its defensive effect and trivialize battles, making them way easier than was intended.
[*] Monster Grasshopper and cards with "on play: attack" effects will no longer appear during the 2nd turn onwards on the Battle in Waves node. These cards would instantly activate on summon, which would do guaranteed damage without a chance for counter-play. By restricting them to the 1st turn, when the player arena is still empty, those effects won't be able to trigger.
[/list]

We have been listening to your feedback and working hard the past days to improve on the game, and will continue to do so! Our next update will be a major one, with new content and the highly requested Deck Editor feature.

Don't forget to [url=https://discord.com/invite/KSUsJ8VnSQ]Join Our Discord[/url] to share your feedback, opinions, criticism or if just want to chat about the game!

We greatly appreciate the support and hope you keep enjoying Primateria!

notes.title: Primateria Playtest: Share Your Thoughts
notes.content:
Dear Primateria Community Members,

Our playtest phase has officially begun! This is your chance to be among the first to experience the exciting changes we've been working on, based on the valuable feedback you provided.

[h2]Here's the issues this Playtest tries to address[/h2]

[list]
[*] Bosses had way more cards than the player and difficulty at beginning of runs was too steep due to small number of cards in deck;
[*] Rewards could not be skipped, making decks too big, especially on late game, and shops were too far in-between;
[*] First quest boss was too difficult for new players;
[*] A "complete run" (doing all quests) was too long of a challenge;
[*] Keeping the same deck throughout all quests made the game too easy for experienced players;
[*] Difficulty of quests and runs was not clear, as it wasn't explicitly displayed;
[*] Battle in Waves node was too punishing for most of the decks, especially due to the lack of a battle phase.
[/list]

[h2]How to Join the Playtest:[/h2]

Joining the playtest is easy! Just activate the "playtest" beta in your Steam client. You can do so by right-clicking Primateria on your Steam library, and navigating to "Properties..." then "Betas". There, just select the "playtest" branch from the dropdown list:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/e00e102e6706da329be514f146b324d6221792c6.png[/img]

For any questions, discussions, feedback, and sharing your playtest experience, please [url=https://discord.com/invite/KSUsJ8VnSQ]Join Our Discord[/url]. 

You can also send feedback through our website https://www.yfrit.com, our contact email contact@yfrit.com or any of our social media platforms.

Your input during this playtest is crucial for us. It's an opportunity to see the changes in action and gather your thoughts on how they impact your gaming experience.

And if you are liking the game, please make a Steam review, we are really close to reaching that sweet "Overwheelmingly Positive" rating.

Looking forward to seeing you in the playtest! Thank you for playing and for the support!

Warm regards,
Yfrit Team.

notes.title: It's here, folks! Primateria is out!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce the launch of Primateria! It's been an incredible journey, and we're delighted with the final product. We can't wait for you to dive in and experience the adventure we've crafted with so much passion.

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]

So what now? With the game released, our journey continues. We're committed to regular updates, squashing any pesky bugs, fine-tuning card balance, and injecting fresh, exciting features and content.

[h2]Get Ready for Deck Editor![/h2]

Up next is a major update that will introduce the Deck Editor feature. Imagine crafting your own decks with all the cards you've unlocked and saving your favorite combinations for future runs. It's going to revolutionize how you play!

Also, we're excited to share that Primateria now supports Spanish, in addition to English, Portuguese, and Chinese. More players around the globe can enjoy our game in their preferred language.

[h2]Streaming Live for Release Week[/h2]

We'll also be broadcasting a first impressions video as a Steam livestream showcasing the game throughout Release Week.

[h2]Join the Adventure![/h2]

Grab your copy of Primateria now and be part of an epic adventure. Your support means everything to us.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1397130/_Primateria/

[h2]We Want to Hear from You![/h2]

If you have feedback, questions, criticism or just want to discuss strategies or say hello, please join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/KSUsJ8VnSQ]Discord Server[/url]. We'd love to hear what you have to say!

notes.title: The Wait is Coming to an End - Jan 8th!
notes.content:
After six long years of development, we're very proud to finally announce that [u]Primateria[/u] will be released on [b]January 8th 2024[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/5753ec3d96c6c8ea76e5a402987ff03095d8610d.png[/img]

This development journey has been incredible for us at [u]Yfrit Games[/u], and we are very excited to show you what we've been cooking.

Here's some of the new and exciting things you can expect on the full game:

[list]
[*]A complete story mode with 9 unique quests, a thrilling story and a bunch of characters!
[*]100+ cards, with hundreds of effects, mechanics and endless combos!
[*]4 new almighty legendary cards with intricate ways to unlock them!
[*]43 Steam achievements for you to challenge yourselves and unlock!
[*]12 unique pre-built decks with specific archetypes for you to explore, including a Random Deck for experienced players to challenge their might!
[*]20+ special items that can be found and used in runs to enhance your chances of reaching the surface!
[*]10+ challenging nodes for exploration!
[*]A new and improved Endless Mode with challenging bosses, enemy encounters, exploration and much more!
[*]A gallery system that serves as a compendium for all cards, items and unlockables in the game so you can track your progress!
[*]A meta-progression system that allows you to gain experience, level up, and unlock all sorts of magical items and cards for your Primateria journey!
[*]And much, much more!
[/list]

We're incredibly excited about the launch, and hope you enjoy the game! We will continue working on the game, adding content, fixing and balancing things, and making sure the [u]Primateria[/u] experience is the best it can be!

Don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1397130/Primateria/]add Primateria to your Steam Wishlist[/url], and mark the date of [b]January 8th 2024[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1397130/Primateria/

See you all at launch!
Yfrit.

notes.title: Here Comes a New Demo!
notes.content:
It's been a while since our last announcement, but that is for a good cause: a whole lot of new content! With the release date fast approaching, we are here to announce a whole new demo with a bunch of new things for you to enjoy.

Since our last demo, the game has improved a lot, as we worked towards implementing and fixing everything pointed out by you guys on the feedback we received.

For version v2.11.2, these are the main changes:

[h2]New Quest System[/h2]

As stated in our livestreams and blog posts, Primateria has an exciting world with intriguing lore and an exciting story told by our new quest system. You can now interact with new characters, unfold mysterious adventures of divine beings and you, the player!

Here are the new features accompanying the system:

[list]
[*] New dialog system with new characters
[*] 3 new quests available
[*] 10 NPCs with unique character design and personalities
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/1d19491e2c761b0e3449847d06597acf2a0f7c1d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/d4fd95182db3f7d2b50e51881a4dcdac6ddb1b62.png[/img]

[h2]More Decks, More Cards[/h2]

With the addition of a bunch more cards, new decks were also introduced alongside new mechanics and playstyles for the game. 

Here are the new things:

[list]
[*] 60+ playable cards 
[*] 4 playable decks
[*] New random deck mechanic for the experienced players looking for a new challenge
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/3a109dd4cb154ed3598e8c8c6b5efabe9ec85e22.png[/img]

[h2]New Legendary Cards[/h2]

To make playing cards even more exciting, new legendary cards can be summoned by fulfilling very specific conditions and challenges during a run. These incredibly powerful cards have amazing new art and represent the divine characters in the game.

Here are our imponent legendary cards:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/f2809253f49e4f580aadf620f4e813d7078162fd.png[/img]

[h2]New Map Exploring Content[/h2]

For a more fun and long term experience, we have completely reworked the map exploring game loop, adding a lot of new content and improvements to it. Here are some of those things:

[list]
[*] 5+ new nodes and gameplay modes
[*] Reworked the shop node
[*] Added a micro-tutorial node and broke down the initial tutorial into a more streamlined experience
[*] New and improved consumables and equipment items
[*] New blessing system that gives the player passive effects and abilities to use on their runs
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/e1d38dfc86ab760d6138bc179159035d4b48672c.png[/img]

[h2]Gallery and Meta-progression System[/h2]

Improving on the roguelite aspect of Primateria, we have reworked the gameloop with a meta-progression system. It allows players to gain experience points and level up on each run they play. Levels are attached to the in-game unlocks, that are now available on the new Gallery system, a resource compendium with everything in the game you can unlock!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/06088d4accce1cdc5dd3930c50e1cb2bbe8473fd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/bd1d844d8d8538be14700c1e44eb82cae9d48177.png[/img]

[h2]UI and Graphics Overhaul[/h2]

Following the feedback we received from the players, we have reworked our UI systems and redone a lot of the graphics to enhance the playing experience and make the game as beautiful as possible.

Here are all the new and reworked features:

[list]
[*] Reworked the card frame
[*] New background art for battle arenas, menus and the map exploring scene
[*] Completely new screen for listing cards, items, and other in-game resources
[*] Improved fonts
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/7a9427aed473e6244b66ef309376b830ddf1a93c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/1930e021d6dc93f71fe89609b4a6619f576433a1.png[/img]

[h2]New and Improved Animations[/h2]

Also listening to your feedback, we have reworked and added a bunch of new animations to the game, making it feel more lively and prettier.

Here are some of those animations:

[list]
[*] New and improved attack animations
[*] New victory/defeat animations
[*] New reward animation
[*] New game state representations animations
[*] New screen transitions
[*] New damage/discard/mana animations
[*] New battle-phase transitions
[*] Improved playing animations
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/f8afbe2c6f8890545b2f228f256af156e8ce446b.png[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixing, Polishing and a Ton of Improvements[/h2]

To enhance the experience for new and experienced players, a lot of quality of life features, bug fixes and changes were introduced. Here's a list of them:

[list]
[*] New run saving system that allows for resuming runs stopped in the middle
[*] Improved usability when playing cards in the backrow
[*] Improved and shortened animations and clicks for multiple actions
[*] New graphical options
[*] Rebalanced and reworked multiple cards and game rules
[*] Improved effect texts to make them more consistent and easier to understand
[*] Improved translations on Portuguese and Chinese versions
[*] New music and sound effects
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831837/b42845ee3ce06a2b488e86f39f02b06034f14870.png[/img]

[h2]More to Come![/h2]

And that's it for this new demo and announcement! We hope you enjoy the new version, we have worked very hard to improve the game as much as possible for the upcoming release. If you have any feedback, feel free to message us on [url=https://discord.gg/XFEWbgQ8]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/yfritgames]X.com (former Twitter)[/url] or our [url=https://www.yfrit.com/]Website[/url].

Thanks and have a good game!

notes.title: Primateria is in the Steam Game Festival
notes.content:
[h1]It's finally here[/h1]

The Steam Game Festival: Autumn Edition is finally here, bringing with it Yfrit Game's brand new game: Primateria!

[h1]Our small, but full of passion studio[/h1]

Composed shyly of three members, Yfrit Games is far from being a big studio, but that doesn't change our love for the craft. In 2018, we brought to the world our first creation, Dual Snake, which was extremely well received, although not widely spread. We heard your feedback! Primateria is coming with a bigger budget, a lot more focus on arts and visuals, an orchestrated OST and much, much love!

[h1]Primateria: Rogue-Like, Deckbuilder, TCG[/h1]

Primateria is not your average card game. Our team didn't measure efforts to bring the true and classic TCG experience into the Rogue-Like universe. In Primateria, battles are more than just choosing cards to attack, but full fledged card duels based on a disruptive and fun, brand new way of playing cards. We at Yfrit believe that creating games signifies proportioning new ways of playing games, creating new and always innovative mechanics with infinite combinations and experiences. In this festival, our goal was to bring to you a portion of those mechanics with the Primateria demo, so that you can experience the duel system we worked hard to create. Of course that's not all! The final project will immerse this duel system within a Rogue-Like adventure in which every decision matters, building a strong deck is the difference between life and death, and choosing the strongest combinations of items, equipment and artifacts will tell if you are worthy of reaching the gods!

[h1]That's it![/h1]

We hope you have a lot of fun with the Primateria demo. Every kind of feedback is heavily appreciated, so feel free to contact us at our social media:

[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?publisher=Yfrit%20Games]Steam[/url]
[*] [url=https://facebook.com/yfritgames]Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/yfritgames]Twitter[/url]
[/list]

Oh, and if you're in Brazil, stay tuned to our [url=https://twitter.com/yfritgames]Twitter[/url], a fun little contest will happen there very soon!

Thanks for everything!
Yfrit Games.
